question: What does an angry one destroy in the triple world?
premises: kruddhaḥ tu saṃharet means when angry he destroys
sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ is all triple world
sa cara acaram means moving and unmoving
inference: An angry one destroys all moving and unmoving things in the triple world.
uncertainties: exact parsing of sa cara acaram
plain_english: When angry, he destroys all moving and unmoving things in the triple world.
